recreating.summary: @julias.algos · "Launch a hedge fund for $89 a month" · https://www.instagram.com/p/DcBejIYR3J2/ · 5,946 likes and 1,363 comments on a 152K-follower account

lines.text: Starting a hedge fund used to mean 50 grand in legal fees and $1,300 a month just to keep it running.
So let's fix that with Hedgia.
Hedgia is a startup backed by a former CEO of BMO Private Wealth Management, and it's letting quants, portfolio managers, and traders launch their own hedge fund without the six-figure price tag.
And if you're based in one of the supported states, you can do this today.
One, set the fees that you want to charge.
Management fee, performance fee, whatever structure you want.
Two, Hedgia auto-generates your entity formation, your fund documents, and your regulatory notice filings, ready for your authorization.
Three, it walks you through every single step, regardless of whether you're a first-time manager or a 15-year industry vet.
And four, your fund goes live for $0 in platform setup costs and state fees, and just for $89 a month.
And once you're set up, you get a fully branded investor portal, your logo, your colors, and your clients logging into your platform.
And when you're ready to trade, it plugs straight into interactive brokers, making placing your first trade a breeze.
And just like that, you have a fully formed fund, a branded investor portal, and a live trading account, all for a fraction of what it used to cost.
Just comment Hedgia and I'll send you the link to get started.

notes: **Recreating:** @julias.algos · https://www.instagram.com/p/DcBejIYR3J2/ · copy its rhythm: a visual change about every 2.7s (28 cuts in 75s); the cost felt before the product shows (gavel-on-cash photo at about 2s); the product named as a fix at the cut on "So let's fix that"; one credibility card right after; no title, the numbered captions "1)", "2)", "3)", "and 4)" do the list work, each landing on the same word the number is said; the price held to step 4 on an old-vs-new card; one full-screen UI moment near the end (here the simulation account); captions only over the recap.

**Layout:** split screen. Images and Qube recordings in the top third (1080×640), Joshua below, filmed wide; one full-screen moment at line 10. Captions per `on-screen-text`: Inter Bold 58px, white, black stroke, 1 to 3 words at a time at chest height (CapCut preset "TQX Captions"), key words in gold #E8B04B. Our own style and our own images, not julias.algos's footage, captions or UI.
**Times** are estimates at Joshua's 3.2 words a second (about 79s plus the 2s end screen). Re-time to the real take.

notes: **Presenter:** Joshua. One person, one list, in video order.
**Before recording anything:** Joshua has a Qube login on his laptop. Don't show any API keys, emails, account numbers, file paths or a broker login.

**Recording order for the Qube clips** (one run, they build on each other): A7 → A8 → A9 → A10 → A11 → A13 → A14. The strategy Joshua builds in A8 is the one tested, improved, saved and run in the rest. It's named "Joshua's breakout".
**No stock ticker is spoken or typed.** The strategy runs on a list of stocks ("the 10 biggest US stocks"), never one named stock.

rows.how: 1. Phone vertical (9:16), eye level, office lights on, lock focus and exposure. 2. Frame wide (head and chest), and leave the top third of the frame empty above his head (the screens go there). 3. Record the hook twice, clean. 4. Record lines 1–12 in one take, brisk, no pauses between lines. 5. Move the phone in close (face fills the frame) and record, three times each: "regardless of whether you're a first-time trader or a 15-year industry vet." · "Just comment QUBE and I'll send you the link for the free sign-up."

rows.what: Step 1: pick a strategy, or type your own
rows.how: 1. On the A7 screen, start recording. 2. Hover the cursor on "Moving-average crossover" for 1s. 3. Hover on "Breakout" for 1s. 4. Open the box where you describe a strategy in plain English. 5. Type exactly, by hand, don't paste: `Buy any of the 10 biggest US stocks when it closes above its 20-day high. Put $2,000 into each trade. Sell once it's up 10% from where I bought, or if it falls 5%.` 6. Name the strategy exactly: `Joshua's breakout`. 7. Press Enter or the build button, and keep recording into A9.

rows.how: 1. Keep recording from A8 while Qube writes the code. 2. When it's done, open the finished strategy and hold 2s on the whole thing. 3. Move the cursor over each section in this order, 1s each: when to buy, when to sell, how much, when to get out. 4. Take one screenshot of the full strategy. **CHECK: the strategy must have those four sections. If Qube names them differently, send Mark the screenshot; the chips in the edit use Qube's own section names.**
